items.raw_excerpt: Aniversariante, Coxa sai na frente com gol contra, mas Glorioso busca igualdade ainda no primeiro tempo. Paranaenses se afastam da briga pelo G5 e se unem aos cariocas na luta para fugirem da zona de rebaixamento.
items.summary_en: Coritiba and Botafogo drew their league match. Coritiba went ahead first with an own goal, but Botafogo tied the game in the first half. Both teams stay without a win and slide toward the relegation fight.

items.raw_excerpt: Crisp, peppery and surprisingly versatile, Austria’s signature white grape comes into its own in the vineyards of Wachau and neighbouring Kamptal.
items.summary_en: Crisp, peppery and versatile, Austria's signature white grape is shining in the vineyards of Wachau and nearby Kamptal. The grape is getting attention as an alternative to Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.
